parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is one half of the scissors consisting of a blade and a handle, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one cutting edge and one handle arm of the scissors, working together with the other blade handle set to perform cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw pivot to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second half of the scissors, also consisting of a blade and a handle, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary cutting edge and handle arm, working with the first blade handle set to cut materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw to move in opposition to the other blade handle set, enabling the cutting motion.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot joint, allowing the two blades to rotate relative to each other while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, serving as the rotational axis for the two blade handle sets.
